# m.partners.benzinga.ratings

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Analyst rating and price-target actions on US stocks, as reported by Benzinga.

Call it from a session `m`:

```python
m.partners.benzinga.ratings(symbols=None, *, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- Query methods: `fetch()`, `poll()`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `BenzingaId`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows the [shared rules](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | US stock tickers; None, the default, for no ticker filter (`dm.ALL` is refused). |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Massive's field to sort by, such as `"date"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Such as `{"rating_action": "upgrades"}`. ## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Analyst Ratings (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Benzinga Analyst Ratings | Updated in real time, All history |
| Benzinga Analyst Ratings Business | Updated in real time, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "The stock symbol of the company being rated." |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. |
| `AdjustedPriceTarget` | double | The current price target adjusted for stock splits and dividends. |
| `Analyst` | String | The name of the individual analyst who issued the rating. |
| `BenzingaAnalystId` | String | The identifier used by Benzinga for this analyst. |
| `BenzingaCalendarUrl` | String | A link to the Benzinga calendar page for this ticker |
| `BenzingaFirmId` | String | The identifier used by Benzinga for this firm. |
| `BenzingaId` | String | The identifier used by Benzinga for this record. |
| `BenzingaNewsUrl` | String | A link to the Benzinga articles page for this ticker |
| `CompanyName` | String | The name of the company being rated. |
| `Currency` | String | The ISO 4217 currency code in which the price target is denominated. |
| `Date` | String | The calendar date (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD) when the rating was issued. |
| `Firm` | String | The name of the research firm or investment bank issuing the rating. |
| `Importance` | long | A subjective indicator of the importance of the event, on a scale from 0 (lowest) to 5 (highest). |
| `LastUpdated` | Instant | The timestamp (formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp) when the rating was last updated in the system. |
| `Notes` | String | Additional context or commentary. |
| `PreviousAdjustedPriceTarget` | double | The previous price target adjusted for stock splits and dividends. |
| `PreviousPriceTarget` | double | The previous price target set by the analyst. |
| `PreviousRating` | String | The previous rating set by the analyst. |
| `PricePercentChange` | double | The percentage change in price target if price target and previous price target exists |
| `PriceTarget` | double | The current price target set by the analyst. |
| `PriceTargetAction` | String | The description of the directional change in price target. Possible values include: raises, lowers, maintains, announces, sets. |
| `Rating` | String | The current rating set by the analyst. |
| `RatingAction` | String | The description of the change in rating from the firm's last rating. Possible values include: downgrades, maintains, reinstates, reiterates, upgrades, assumes, initiates_coverage_on, terminates_coverage_on, removes, suspends, firm_dissolved. |
| `Time` | String | The time (formatted as 24-hour HH:MM:SS UTC) when the rating was issued. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. |
